data.name: MORKO
data.detailed_description:
MORKO is a realistic sci-fi command simulation where you captain your warship and lead a mercenary company through a dangerous and persistent world. Fly solo or with friends in a dynamic sandbox campaign.

THE SHIP

Build your ship from the ground up. Customize weapons, modules and manage your crew to suit your playstyle. Evolve your ship for the tactics you enjoy. Experiment and create builds.

  • Long range rail guns for precision strikes.

  • Missile racks to overwhelm the enemy defenses with devastating salvos.

  • Close-in weapon systems to shred enemy vessels and missiles apart.

Play as a silent hunter that stalks the battlefield, a carrier commanding flight squadrons or as a battleship to take a more direct approach to charge combat head on.

THE COMBAT

Every vessel  has a unique dynamic flight model with multiple thrusters. Mass, engines and loadout affects flight characteristics. Command your ship in real time through a virtual pilot and crew interpreting your orders. Locational damage and module based simulations are the core part of combat. Stealth and detection plays a big role - knowledge is power.

  • Plan maneuvers to flank.

  • Target sensors to blind enemies.

  • Target engines for easier follow up strikes.

  • Use environment and decoys to avoid detection

But be careful, the playing field is level, what works for you will work for AI and other players. With a shared equipment pool and balanced modules tactics will be the determining factor in combat.

THE WORLD

Explore a vast, faction-torn universe. You are not alone - factions fighting for control and other mercenary companies following their own agendas. Uncover the secrets of the cracked planet as you take on contracts.

  • Assist factions to extend their influence and gain benefits.

  • Double cross factions when opportunity arises. 

  • Your faction relations determine your allies and enemies.

  • Hunt bounties for factions or be hunted.

  • Engage in piracy.

The universe is yours to explore, carve your path, seize your fortune, leave your mark in MORKO.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 or AMD Radeon RX 5500
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
